raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

Part of #41152.

With a single KV pool and the default `page_size` 1, `_apply_cuda_graph_metadata` builds the decode page indices but never copies them into `cuda_graph_page_table`. Only the SWA-pool branch and the `page_size > 1` branch do the copy. Unified attention then replays every CUDA-graph decode step against a stale page table and produces garbage from the second generated token on. Eager decode (`--disable-cuda-graph`) builds its own table and is unaffected.

`_transform_table_1_to_real` is a no-op at `page_size` 1, so the fix takes the existing copy branch for every page size.

Affected: any model on the aiter unified path with a single pool and `page_size` 1 under CUDA graphs. That includes Gemma 2/3, whose only aiter decode path is unified attention, and any model forced onto it with `SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN=1`.

## Results (1× MI325X, TP1, default CUDA graphs)

8 fixed chat prompts, temperature 0, max 256 tokens, `SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN=1`:

| model | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| Gemma 3 4B | every reply turns to garbage after the first token and runs to 256 tokens | matches triton: reply lengths 84/51/78/39/19/106 vs triton 84/52/78/39/19/106; "Count from 1 to 20" identical |
| Qwen3-8B | garbage (`<think>();++邾ETOELS =~GetInstance…`) | coherent |

GSM8K (lm_eval, temperature 0, strict / flexible):

| model | this PR | reference |
|---|---|---|
| Gemma 3 4B | 0.831 / 0.831 | triton 0.832 / 0.832 |
| Qwen3-8B | 0.930 / 0.935 | aiter default backend 0.935 / 0.939 |

On main, GSM8K does not finish on this path because generations never stop.

Three more models, same settings. On main each one answers "The" and then produces garbage until the 256-token limit (`The ( ( ( ( …` on Llama 3.1 8B, `The处罚 กลۆ paddock…` on Gemma 3 12B):

| model | reply lengths, this PR | reply lengths, reference | GSM8K this PR | GSM8K reference |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Llama 3.1 8B | 91/76/86/64/8/21/105/256 | identical (aiter default backend) | 0.837 / 0.838 | 0.834 / 0.836 |
| Gemma 2 9B | 123/78/45/72/15/52/5/246 | 123/77/45/72/15/52/5/252 (triton) | 0.845 / 0.846 | 0.842 / 0.843 |
| Gemma 3 12B | 256/72/54/79/34/50/95/256 | identical (triton) | 0.933 / 0.933 | 0.933 / 0.932 |

`page_size` > 1 takes the same code path before and after this change. As a control, Qwen3-8B with `--page-size 16` gives the same replies on main and this PR, at the same throughput (1024 in / 512 out at concurrency 4: 580.0 vs 584.4 tok/s; 4096 / 512 at concurrency 32: 1582.7 vs 1609.6 tok/s).

Not fixed here: decode on the unified path is also slow at small batch and long context. Two running requests at about 5K tokens decode at about 11 tok/s on Gemma 3 4B, while triton runs one such request at about 83 tok/s. That is the throughput gap reported in #41152 and needs a separate look.

## Test plan

- [x] New `test_aiter_unified_graph_page_table.py`: decode replay writes the page table for `page_size` 1 and 16; the `page_size` 1 case fails without this fix
- [x] End-to-end outputs and GSM8K above: Gemma 3 4B/12B, Gemma 2 9B, Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen3-8B, plus the `page_size` 16 control

Found by [Hyperloom](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Hyperloom); reviewed and measured by hand.
Hyperloom was optimizing `allenai/Olmo-3-7B-Instruct` (#41012); this bug showed up while checking the same fix on `google/gemma-3-4b-it` (#41143).

files.patch:
@@ -2422,7 +2422,7 @@ def _apply_cuda_graph_metadata(
                             kv_indices[:new_rows, :new_cols].copy_(page_indices)
                             swa_page_table = self.cuda_graph_swa_page_table
                             swa_page_table[:new_rows, :new_cols].copy_(swa_page_indices)
-                        elif self.page_size > 1:
+                        else:
                             page_indices = self._transform_table_1_to_real(page_indices)
                             new_rows = page_indices.shape[0]
                             new_cols = page_indices.shape[1]

@@ -0,0 +1,73 @@
+"""AITER unified attention: CUDA-graph decode refreshes the block page table."""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_hip
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_amd_ci(est_time=20, suite="stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd")
+
+_RUNNABLE = is_hip()
+if _RUNNABLE:
+    from sglang.srt.layers.attention.aiter_backend import AiterAttnBackend
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(_RUNNABLE, "requires HIP with AITER")
+class TestAiterUnifiedGraphPageTable(CustomTestCase):
+    MAX_BS = 4
+    MAX_CONTEXT_LEN = 64
+
+    def _make_backend(self, page_size):
+        backend = object.__new__(AiterAttnBackend)
+        backend.use_mla = False
+        backend.use_triton_unified_attention = True
+        backend.use_sliding_window_kv_pool = False
+        backend.page_size = page_size
+        backend.max_context_len = self.MAX_CONTEXT_LEN
+        backend.device = "cuda"
+        num_reqs = 6
+        backend.req_to_token = (
+            torch.randperm(num_reqs * self.MAX_CONTEXT_LEN, device="cuda")
+            .to(torch.int32)
+            .view(num_reqs, self.MAX_CONTEXT_LEN)
+        )
+        backend.cuda_graph_page_table = torch.zeros(
+            (self.MAX_BS, -(-self.MAX_CONTEXT_LEN // page_size)),
+            dtype=torch.int32,
+            device="cuda",
+        )
+        backend.qo_indptr_unified_decode = torch.arange(
+            self.MAX_BS + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"
+        )
+        return backend
+
+    def test_decode_replay_writes_page_table(self):
+        req_pool_indices = torch.tensor([4, 1, 3], device="cuda")
+        seq_lens = torch.tensor([5, 17, 33], device="cuda")
+        bs = len(seq_lens)
+        for page_size in (1, 16):
+            with self.subTest(page_size=page_size):
+                backend = self._make_backend(page_size)
+                backend._apply_cuda_graph_metadata(
+                    bs,
+                    req_pool_indices,
+                    seq_lens,
+                    int(seq_lens.sum()),
+                    ForwardMode.DECODE,
+                    None,
+                    seq_lens.cpu(),
+                    None,
+                )
+                expected = backend.req_to_token[req_pool_indices, : int(seq_lens.max())]
+                if page_size > 1:
+                    expected = expected[:, ::page_size] // page_size
+                table = backend.forward_metadata.kv_indices
+                self.assertIs(table, backend.cuda_graph_page_table)
+                self.assertTrue(torch.equal(table[:bs, : expected.shape[1]], expected))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
